name: atp-provenance-logging
description: Line-item provenance for agent work: the hooks forward each session's transcript to Prove, which records every step as a hash-chained child of one root per prompt, plus the ATP skill, the Mission Control dashboard and a bundled local service. Runs hosted, standalone, or fully offline.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: standalone (default): Prove runs on this machine and starts with your session. offline: same, and nothing may leave this machine. hosted: send provenance to your own deployed Prove.

service_url.title: Prove service URL
service_url.description: Hosted mode: your Prove base URL (https). Standalone: leave empty for the bundled local service, or point at your own instance. Offline: loopback only.

api_token.title: Hosted API token
api_token.description: Bearer token for a hosted Prove. Sent only in hosted mode, only over https.

ledger_path.title: Local ledger file
ledger_path.description: Where the local service keeps its SQLite ledger. Empty means ~/.prove/provenance.db.

capture.title: Capture sessions
capture.description: Forward each session's transcript to Prove so every step is recorded. Turn off to keep only the skill.

autostart.title: Start the local service
autostart.description: Standalone and offline: start the bundled Prove at session start if it is not already running.

strict.title: Block the session if Prove is down
strict.description: Off by default: an outage shows a warning and the session continues. On: session start fails until Prove is reachable.
